# SwedeHF database 5 (SHFDB5)

A Heart Failure cohort from Sweden 2000 - 2024. The population consists of 

1) patients recorded in the Swedish Heart Failure Registry (SwedeHF), 

2) patients recorded in the National Patient Register with an ICD-10 code for HF,

3) patients recorded in primary care in Region Uppsala, Kalmar, Stockholm or Västra Götaland with an ICD-10 code for HF,

4) gender, year of birth and county of residence matched HF-free controls for SwedeHF.


Please feel free to [contact me](mailto:lina.benson@ki.se) if you have any questions.
